ns2:course.label: Cello
ns2:course.description: Instruction in cello at the undergraduate level. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in the same term up to 4 hours or in separate terms up to 16 hours, if instructors vary. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course. Music majors must register concurrently in an approved university orchestra.
